newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-INJURED SCAGLIA TO MISS ENGLAND MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-INJURED SCAGLIA TO MISS ENGLAND MATCH.

text.p: Italy lost another member of their squad for next Saturday's rugby union friendly match against England at Twickenham after lock Diego Scaglia twisted an ankle.
The Italian federation said on Wednesday that Scaglia, who injured himself in training on Tuesday, would be replaced by Carlo Checchinato.

Winger Massimo Ravazzolo was dropped from the 21-man squad on Tuesday after pulling a muscle. His place has gone to Nicola Mazzucato. The Italians leave for London on Thursday and will train at Twickenham on Friday morning.
